shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for white cards on the cool gray ground.

shadows.name: primary-button
shadows.purpose: Small depth cue for the primary action.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a management screen.
components.css: .button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 37px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #2563eb; color: #fff; font: 600 11px Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .button:hover { background: #1d4ed8; }

components.name: Management Card
components.description: A white bounded surface for token details and creation controls.
components.html:
Access token

Manage permissions for this token.
components.css: .card { padding: 19px 20px; border: 1px solid #e7ebf0; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #182338; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(36, 50, 74, 0.024); font: 400 12px/1.65 Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .card p { color: #778397; }

narrative.northStar: A calm control surface for personal mailbox access.
narrative.overview: The management UI follows the user-selected light administration reference. It keeps the mailbox identity and token controls easy to scan, with a compact navigation rail, restrained blue actions, white cards, and clear status labels.
keyCharacteristics: Blue primary actions and permission switches

rules.name: Mailbox-first context
rules.body: Keep the connected mailbox identity close to token management.

rules.name: One-time secret
rules.body: Show the full user token only when created and provide a copy action.

rules.name: Conditional SMTP
rules.body: Expose send permission only when SMTP is configured.

dos: Use blue for primary actions and permission controls.
Keep each permission labeled and independently operable.
donts: Do not add unrelated dashboard or team navigation.
Do not use heavy shadows or decorative display type.
